The manifest therefore records t1_live_db_precondition: 'deferred_to_ci' under the route B admission ratified 2026-09-07. The deferral moves where the live-DB evidence is obtained, not whether it is obtained: truth-check G6 re-asserts both `verify` and `Writable DB proof (staging only)` directly on the merge SHA at closeout and refuses without them.
runtime_proof.non_vacuity: The live suite was not mutation-tested; mutating it costs a full staging run. Its anti-vacuity control is inside the suite and is stronger than a build-level mutation would have been: both tests run in the same process, against the same database, with the same armed `events` table and the same run-unique event name matching no row. The ONLY difference is whether the submission carries a server-validated fallback outcome. Test 2 was refused and test 1 was accepted, which isolates the waiver as the cause of the acceptance. The predicate itself is separately mutation-tested four ways in process.
